headerDisplay: ChargeCore accepts OCPP 1.6 JSON charger connections and exposes each charger as a HomeKit outlet. Restrict network access to the listening port.
footerDisplay: Configure the charger with `ws://HOME_BRIDGE_HOST:PORT/chargecore` and no trailing slash. It appends `/CHARGEBOX_ID` when connecting. The base path is fixed and cannot be changed. Use `wss://` when TLS is configured.

host.title: Listen Address
host.description: Use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces or a specific local address.

tls.title: TLS (optional)
tls.description: Leave unset to use plain ws://. When enabled, both certificate and private-key paths are required.

clientCaPath.title: Client CA Path (optional mTLS)
clientCaPath.description: When set, clients must present a certificate signed by this CA.

offlineAfterSeconds.title: Offline Timeout
offlineAfterSeconds.description: Mark a charger unavailable after this many seconds without telemetry. Use at least three telemetry intervals.

logWebSocketTraffic.title: Log All WebSocket Traffic
logWebSocketTraffic.description: Log OCPP connection attempts, rejections, raw messages, commands, acknowledgements, disconnects, and heartbeat frames. Payloads may contain sensitive charger data.

commandAckTimeoutSeconds.title: Command Acknowledgement Timeout
commandAckTimeoutSeconds.description: 0 sends OCPP controls without waiting. A positive value waits for the OCPP CALLRESULT or CALLERROR.

allowedChargerIds.title: Allowed Charger IDs
allowedChargerIds.description: Optional allow-list. If empty, any charger id is accepted. This is an identifier filter, not authentication.

exposeVehicleSensor.title: Expose Vehicle Sensor
exposeVehicleSensor.description: Adds a contact sensor that indicates whether a vehicle is plugged in.
